scientific.integrity: The algebraic identities, isolating interval, physical-branch inequalities, and numerical value are replayable from the bundled exact-rational verifier; decimal output is supplementary.
scientific.limitations: The result is restricted to the second translation-invariant critical coupling of the three-state hardcore-SOS model at p=infinity on the Cayley tree of order 3; it does not re-prove the phase-count theorem or address extremality.

title: An exact quintic for the \(k=3\) hardcore-SOS critical coupling
